title: Samsung Claims Lead in Race to Ship AI Chips to Nvidia
title_zh: 三星声称在向 Nvidia 运送 AI 芯片的竞赛中处于领先地位
summary: The company said on Thursday it had sent the first commercial shipments of HBM4 to customers, without naming Nvidia, signaling a comeback after falling behind domestic contender SK Hynix Inc. in recent years.
summary_zh: 该公司周四表示，已向客户发送了首批 HBM4 商业出货量，但未点名英伟达，这标志着近年来落后于国内竞争者 SK 海力士公司后的东山再起。

title: Bitcoin price steadies but fresh fears suggest slide to $52k
title_zh: 比特币价格稳定，但新的担忧表明比特币价格跌至 5.2 万美元
summary: Bitcoin price is up roughly 1% over the past 24 hours, but remains down nearly 4.7% over the past week.
summary_zh: 比特币价格在过去 24 小时内上涨了约 1%，但在过去一周仍下跌了近 4.7%。

title: Gold rally loses steam after strong US jobs data
title_zh: 美国就业数据强劲后金价涨势失去动力
summary: Stronger-than-expected US January jobs data dented expectations for near-term interest rate cuts.
summary_zh: 强于预期的美国 1 月份就业数据削弱了近期降息的预期。

title: FTSE 100 LIVE: Stocks higher as GDP figures paint mixed picture of growth
title_zh: 富时 100 实时指数：GDP 数据描绘出喜忧参半的增长图景，股市走高
summary: UK economy grew by 0.1% in the final quarter of 2025, but the growth was slower than economists had expected.
summary_zh: 英国经济2025年最后一个季度增长0.1%，但增速低于经济学家预期。

title: WhatsApp Says Russia Tries to Block Its Messaging Service
title_zh: WhatsApp 称俄罗斯试图阻止其消息服务
summary: WhatsApp, owned by Meta Platforms Inc., said in a statement Wednesday that it was doing everything it could to keep its more than 100 million Russian users connected.
summary_zh: Meta Platforms Inc. 旗下的 WhatsApp 在周三的一份声明中表示，该公司正在竭尽全力保持 1 亿多俄罗斯用户的联网。

title: UK housing market showing early signs of recovery, surveyors say
title_zh: 调查人员表示，英国房地产市场显示出复苏的早期迹象
summary: Price drops also appear to be stabilising, according to data compiled by Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors
summary_zh: 根据英国皇家特许测量师学会编制的数据，价格下跌似乎也趋于稳定

title: UK's favourite supermarket revealed
title_zh: 英国最受欢迎的超市揭晓
summary: Marks & Spencer has been named the UK's favourite supermarket for the fifth year in a row, according to the latest Which? annual ranking.
summary_zh: 根据最新的《Which?》杂志，Marks & Spencer 连续第五年被评为英国最受欢迎的超市。年度排名。

title: The UK's most affordable city for single homebuyers
title_zh: 英国单身购房者最负担得起的城市
summary: Zoopla has revealed the areas where singles can buy for under £800 per month.
summary_zh: Zoopla 透露了单身人士每月可以花 800 英镑以下购买的区域。

title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise after jobs surprise puts focus back on Fed's rate path
title_zh: 今日股市：就业意外让人们重新关注美联储的利率路径，道琼斯指数、标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克期货上涨
summary: Wall Street is gearing up for an update on the Fed's favored inflation gauge after the jobs report bolstered the case against cutting rates.
summary_zh: 在就业报告支持反对降息的理由后，华尔街正准备更新美联储青睐的通胀指标。
